description: This file defines abstract model classes and interfaces for the Superset core API, including models for datasets, databases, charts, dashboards, users, queries, tasks, and related entities. It also includes function signatures for session management and method placeholders to be replaced during runtime initialization.

classes.name: CoreModel
classes.description: Abstract base class extending Flask-AppBuilder's Model, serving as the parent for all Superset models.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: Abstract class defining the contract for database models, including properties and methods for execution and metadata.

classes.name: Dataset
classes.description: Abstract class for dataset models, specifying attributes related to data sources and configurations.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: Abstract interface for chart/slice models, including visualization and datasource attributes.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Abstract interface for dashboard models, including title, layout, and metadata attributes.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Abstract user model interface with user identity and activity status attributes.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: Abstract query model interface with query status and execution attributes.

classes.name: SavedQuery
classes.description: Abstract saved query model interface with query details and metadata.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: Abstract tag model interface with name and type attributes.

classes.name: KeyValue
classes.description: Abstract key-value store model interface with resource, value, and expiration attributes.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Abstract task model representing async tasks, including payload and properties management.

classes.name: TaskSubscriber
classes.description: Abstract model for tracking task subscriptions for multi-user shared tasks.

methods.name: get_session
methods.description: Function to retrieve the SQLAlchemy scoped session for database interactions.
